source: extra_core.csv -> config/extra_refs.yaml (one-way transform, scripts/normalize_extra_refs.py); meta.source_csv_sha256 anchors this dist to the exact CSV vintage.

metrics.label: Abortion legalization year
metrics.note: Year abortion was first legalized, one year per country.

metrics.label: Abortion rate
metrics.note: Legally induced abortions per 1,000 live births, as reported by the countries of the WHO European Region.

metrics.label: Crude birth rate
metrics.note: Live births per 1,000 population. UN Demographic Yearbook Table 9 (2007-2024), plus the 1974-1978 prints of vanished states from the 1978 edition.

metrics.label: Divorce legalization year
metrics.note: Year divorce became legally available, one year per country.

metrics.label: Drug-induced deaths
metrics.note: Deaths directly induced by drugs (overdoses and poisonings by drugs) per 100,000 inhabitants, for European countries.

metrics.label: Life expectancy at age 60
metrics.note: Years of life remaining at age 60, by sex. UN Demographic Yearbook Tables 21 and 22.

metrics.label: Maternal deaths
metrics.note: Registered maternal deaths (a count). UN Demographic Yearbook Table 17, 2001-2022.

metrics.label: Maternal mortality ratio
metrics.note: Maternal deaths per 100,000 live births. UN Demographic Yearbook Table 17, 2001-2022.

metrics.label: Mean years of schooling
metrics.note: Average number of years of formal education completed by the population aged 25 and over.

metrics.label: PISA reading scores
metrics.note: Mean PISA reading score of 15-year-old students.

metrics.label: Road accident mortality per motor vehicle
metrics.note: Road deaths per 10,000 registered motor vehicles. OECD / ITF IRTAD safety indicators, 1994-2024.

metrics.label: PISA science scores
metrics.note: Mean PISA science score of 15-year-old students.

metrics.label: Women's suffrage introduction year
metrics.note: Year women obtained the right to vote in national elections, one year per country.

metrics.label: Youth suicide rate
metrics.note: Deaths by suicide per 100,000 young people aged 15 to 24, for European countries.
